target.title: fix ios qr scanner lifecycle
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

iOS QR setup could crash or become unstable when the VisionKit scanner started during controller construction, before UIKit had fully presented the scanner sheet. This was reported only on iOS, not Android.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Moves `DataScannerViewController.startScanning()` out of `makeUIViewController` and into the presented controller lifecycle.
- Wraps the VisionKit scanner in a small container controller so scanning starts in `viewDidAppear` and stops in `viewWillDisappear`/SwiftUI dismantle.
- Keeps the QR result handoff behavior intact while making teardown explicit.
- Updates the source guard test to preserve the new scanner lifecycle invariant.
- Includes two narrow iOS build-unblock fixes found while proving the patch on device:
  - SwiftFormat-normalizes one static helper reference in `CommandCenterTab`.
  - Avoids Swift 6 sendability diagnostics around the SQLite connection borrow used during command cancellation.

## User Impact

Users should be able to open the iOS QR scanner without the camera session racing sheet presentation/teardown. The scanner still reports unavailable camera state and scanner startup failure through the existing error path.
